acceptance_gate.condition: per_candidate_auroc >= 0.85 AND non_degeneracy_assert == true AND positive_control_valid == true AND adversarial_verify_clean == true
acceptance_gate.principle: A trustworthy selection verdict requires discrimination reproduced (>=0.85, NOT exp3682's 0.55 collapse), the fixes genuinely distinct (non-degeneracy), a valid positive control, and adversarial-clean -- otherwise it repeats the exp3682 degenerate-test trap.

block_reason: cached per-candidate energy corpus unavailable or below min_examples; raw exp3672 JSONL generations are not enough to reproduce per_candidate_auroc before testing fixes

field_principles.adversarial_verify_clean: True iff no TAUTOLOGY/critical flag -- the exp3682 fix.
field_principles.best_fix_vs_sc_delta_ci: Paired delta + bootstrap CI + McNemar of the BEST fix vs SC -- the gap-closure magnitude + significance.
field_principles.inference_substrate: Best-of-N over cached candidates; no LLM generation; no compute-bound marker.
field_principles.non_degeneracy_assert: True iff the fixes produce DISTINCT selection accuracies (not all identical) -- the load-bearing guard against repeating exp3682.
field_principles.oracle_bestofn_accuracy: Upper bound; must exceed SC for the positive control (selectable headroom).
field_principles.per_candidate_auroc: Cross-question discrimination -- MUST reproduce ~0.93 (>=0.85); a collapse to 0.55 is the exp3682 bug, not a finding.
field_principles.per_fix_flip_counts: Selections changed by EACH fix vs SC -- distinct, non-zero flip counts prove the fixes are not no-ops (the exp3682 degeneracy guard).
field_principles.positive_control_valid: True iff oracle > SC AND flips > 0 -- without it the null is uninformative (the P0.1 lesson).
field_principles.sc_selection_accuracy: Majority-vote SC baseline accuracy -- the bar.
field_principles.selection_accuracy_per_question_normaliz: FIX A: selection after a REAL within-question normalization -- must be DISTINCT from the others.
field_principles.selection_accuracy_pessimistic_lcb: FIX B: pessimistic LCB BoN selection (arXiv:2604.04648).
field_principles.selection_gap_closed: BARE bool. True iff at least one fix makes selection beat SC with the delta CI excluding 0, positive-control-valid AND non-degeneracy-asserted -- the diagnosis verdict. STORE AS BARE true/false.
field_principles.within_question_rank_corr: Energy-vs-correctness rank correlation WITHIN questions -- the decoupling measure (arXiv:2512.23067).

inference_substrate: verifier_ensemble_against_cached_candidates (principle: best-of-N over cached candidates; no LLM generation; no compute-bound marker).
